entry.title: Check the work
entry.use_when: Test a finished result against the request and its real destination.
entry.scope: Proportionate verification, narrow repair and a clear account of observed results
entry.freshness: Check the current request, artifact and destination before dependent use.
entry.limitations: Instructions for an existing assistant; destination access, authorization and successful outcomes are not implied.

pattern.activation: a finished deliverable needs to be checked against its requirements and tried where it will be used.

use_cases.title: Check before handoff
use_cases.outcome: A corrected result with specific passed, failed and unverified checks.

use_cases.title: Try it where it will be used
use_cases.outcome: Observed destination behavior and the exact step still untested, if any.

links.why: Design broader test coverage when a final artifact check is not enough.
Examine interface friction in depth when a destination test exposes it.
